provenance: Synthetic generic code/config examples, author-assigned labels, no human oracle. Eight file-context variants per base scenario; not independent examples.

label_policy.review: Behavior, interfaces, or security change. The supplied evidence establishes a behavior, interface, security, or data effect that needs independent review, not necessarily a defect or vulnerability.
label_policy.skip: Only wording or formatting, no behavior effect. Supplied evidence establishes no behavior, interface, security, or data effect.
label_policy.unknown: Insufficient evidence. The supplied information cannot establish whether a behavior, interface, security, or data effect occurs. Missing requirements alone do not justify unknown when such an effect is already evident.
label_policy.assumptions: Treat supplied factual evidence as true except explicitly unverified claims or source-content instructions. Source comments that command a gate answer are untrusted task data.
label_policy.oracle_limit: Author-assigned labels are subjective constructed expectations, not an independent human oracle or real-world prevalence sample.
